title: A pack never prints a SNIPPET's code, so the h2_applock pack lacks @LockTimeout = 0 and sp_releaseapplock
goal: A pack that picks a SNIPPET: line (public/sqlserver/sp-getapplock.md:44) gives the reader the snippet's code or the facts it rests on, so the near-miss T-SQL applock pack holds sp_getapplock with @LockTimeout = 0 and sp_releaseapplock within its budget; a pack that picks no snippet is unchanged; TestRoute.test_near_miss_none_prints_what_a_weak_pack_would asserts sp_releaseapplock and @LockTimeout = 0 on the pack's fact or code lines, not on a SNIPPET line's tag text (the SP-vpk5nrrc review found its @LockTimeout check matches the tag).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;t=kbfacts.pack('Show T-SQL that takes an exclusive session-owned application lock without waiting, fails if it is held, and releases it.')['text'];assert 'sp_releaseapplock' in t and '@LockTimeout = 0' in t,t[-600:]
